+    def search(assigned, constraints):
+        nonlocal best_vector, best_install
+        for name, row in assigned.items():
+            version = row["version"]
+            if any(not low <= version <= high
+                   for low, high in constraints.get(name, [])):
+                return
+
+        unresolved = sorted(set(constraints) - set(assigned))
+        if not unresolved:
+            edges = {}
+            for name, row in assigned.items():
+                edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                               if not dep.get("feature", "") or
+                               dep.get("feature") in features]
+            if not acyclic(edges):
+                return
+            vector = tuple(assigned[name]["version"] if name in assigned else -1
+                           for name in names)
+            if best_vector is None or vector < best_vector:
+                best_vector = vector
+                best_install = {name: row["version"]
+                                for name, row in assigned.items()}
+            return
+
+        name = unresolved[0]
+        ranges = constraints[name]
+        rows = sorted(packages.get(name, []), key=lambda row: row["version"])
+        for row in rows:
+            version = row["version"]
+            if any(not low <= version <= high for low, high in ranges):
+                continue
+            if version in blocked.get(name, []):
+                continue
+            if name in pins and version != pins[name]:
+                continue
+            next_assigned = dict(assigned)
+            next_assigned[name] = row
+            next_constraints = {key: list(value)
+                                for key, value in constraints.items()}
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                next_constraints.setdefault(dep["name"], []).append(
+                    (dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+            search(next_assigned, next_constraints)
+
+    roots = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+    search({}, roots)

+def _component_07(data):
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    if mandatory & blocked:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_ids = None
+    best_value = None
+    for subset in combinations(options, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        intervals = sorted((job["start"], job["end"]) for job in subset)
+        if any(intervals[i][0] < intervals[i - 1][1]
+               for i in range(1, len(intervals))):
+            continue
+        selected = tuple(sorted(ids))
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and selected < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+
+    if best_ids is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
